title: The operating system must enable an application firewall, if available.
check_content: Verify the operating system enabled an application firewall, if available. If it does not, this is a finding. If the operating system does not support an application firewall, this may be downgraded to a CAT III finding.
fixtext: Ensure the operating system's application firewall is enabled, if available.
VulnDiscussion: Firewalls protect computers from network attacks by blocking or limiting access to open network ports. Application firewalls limit which applications are allowed to communicate over the network.
